info.name: Instagram Pink Theme with Stories & Chats
info.description: Transform your Instagram experience with a soft and stylish pink aesthetic. This theme changes the background, navigation, chat interface, and story posting modal to various blush pink tones, creating a unified, elegant look. Hover effects and interactive elements like buttons and text fields also get a subtle pink accent for a seamless visual upgrade.
info.additionalInfo:
Version 1.0: Initial release with a complete pink transformation for all Instagram sections, including:
Chats (Direct Messages and individual bubbles).
Story creation modal (backgrounds, buttons, and text fields).
Posts (backgrounds, comments, and interactions).
Navigation bar, sidebar, and footer.
Pink scrollbars for consistent styling.
Designed for Instagram desktop using the Stylish browser extension.
Fully responsive to light/dark mode toggles on Instagram.
Note: Compatible with most Instagram updates as of December 2024. Further adjustments may be needed if major UI changes occur.
Let me know if you'd like any other details added! ?
